name: lurifycase
description: Monorepo Iurify Case: backend Spring Boot + app móvil Expo

scripts.dev: node scripts/free-ports.mjs && node scripts/ensure-db.mjs && concurrently --kill-others --names api,app --prefix-colors green,magenta --handle-input --default-input-target app "node scripts/start-backend.mjs" "node scripts/start-mobile.mjs"
scripts.db:up: node scripts/ensure-docker.mjs && docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait
